Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 3/9/32.

Communist Propaganda - Result of Court Proceedings

Tseu Dong Hai (周同海) who was arrested by the
Municipal Police on August 12, in a straw hut No. 255 off
Macao Road on a charge of propagating communism (Vide
I.R. 13/8/32), appeared on remand before the Special Branch
Kiangsu High Court on September 2, when he was ordered to
be handed over to the Chinese authorities.

Date 5/1/32

Sheet NO.2

Proceedings Mr.Len appeared for the S.M.C.

Accused:-I know Tai Ah Nyi. I live in a straw hut on Maocao
Rd. I used to work as a coolie in the Doong Shing cotton mill.
I do not know if there was a union there. I did not know that Tai
Ah Nyi was holding a meeting in the theatre. I knew that he had been
arrested but I did not know what it was for. I did not attend the
meeting in the theatre neither did I take Tai Ah Nyi there.

Judge, to accused:-According to the evidence at Nanking Tai Ah Nyi
states that you took him to the theatre and that you are the pres-
ident of the union. I am not the president of the union. I do not
know Siau Li neither I go to the meeting with him.

Mr.Len:-There was nothing found in the house of the accused when
he was arrested, but he has been implicated by the man at Nanking
and the representative has produced prima-facie evidence so the
S.M.C.have no objection to the accused being handed over to the
S.P.S.Bureau.

Decision Accused. to be handed over to the representative of the S.P.S.B.

Proceedings
Mr. T S Lee appeared for the Police.
Mr. Lee :- This is an application made by the Public Safety Bureau for the extradition of the accused. At 8.30.P.M. yesterday a representative of the Public Safety Bureau with a detective attached to the Special Branch went to the Pestee Road Police Station armed with a warrant to arrest Tam Kwong Wing and a search warrant for a hut off the Macao Road. The necessary assistance was rendered by the Pestee Road Station and accused was arrested in the hut off the Macao Road, a search was made but nothing of incriminating nature was found. The representative of the Public Safety Bureau is in Court today and he states that accused was implicated by a man who has been transferred to Nanking. I ask that the Public Safety Bureau be requested to make out a prima facie case before the accused is extradited.

C.D.S. 4 :- At 8.30.P.M. yesterday D.J.I. Taglin and myself rendered assistance to the representative of the Public Safety Bureau and a detective attached to the Special Branch to arrest the accused at a hut off the Macao Road.

Tang Seong Sung Rep. S.Police :- To received a despatch from Nanking stating the accused was implicated by one of 33 men who were arrested in a theatre off Nottoway Road and transferred to Nanking for trial. He applied to this Court for a warrant for his arrest. I ask that accused be handed over for trial.

Accused :- I was formerly a coolie in the Tung Shing Mill. I cannot read. There was a strike there and I joined a union but I do not know how it was organized. I am not a communist.

Accused to be temporarily detained, pending production of proof by the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsou Dong Hai.
native of Yien Zung of Koupo. taken by me C.D.C.317.
at P.Rd.Station on the 12.8.32. and interpreted by Chang Wen Ta.

My name is Tsou Dong Hai, aged 21, native of Yien Sung of Koupo,
now residing at a straw hut No.255 off Macao Road. I came to
Shanghai at the beginning of October 1929 and resided at resides
at an unknown number house in Yan Poo Li off Sze Chuen Road. At
that time I was employed as a motor truck coolie by the Loo Hong
Ke Motor Truck Company, Han Chung Road, Chapai, until the 6.1.30
when I was dismissed and then commenced work at the Dong Shing
Cotton Mill 131 Gordon Road as a oil cleaner and joined the Dong
Shing Labour Union. I was dismissed from the mill in April this
year. Through the introduction of a foreman named Liu Siau Chiu
Ts I am at present working as a coolie in a contractor's workshop
near Stone Bridge Chapel. I am not a member of any Communist
party. This is my true statement.

Signed and cross-marked by Tsou Dong Hai.

Witness: C.D.C.317.
